'''''Oktagon 82: Engizek vs. Jotko''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Oktagon MMA]] on January 17, 2026, in [[Düsseldorf]], Germany.

===Background===
In the final of [[2025 in Oktagon MMA#Oktagon Middleweight Tournament|Oktagon Middleweight Tournament]] bout between the current [[Oktagon MMA#Middleweight championship|Oktagon Middleweight Champion]] Kerim Engizek and [[Krzysztof Jotko]] headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-15 |title=Poznáme miesto a dátum veľkého finále Tipsport Gamechanger v strednej váhe, v ktorom nastúpia Engizek a Jotko! 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/pozname-miesto-a-datum-velkeho-finale-tipsport-gamechanger-v-strednej-vahe-v-ktorom-nastupia-engizek-a-jotko/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

A middleweight bout between Dominik Humburger and Jamie Cordero was scheduled for this event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-30 |title=Dominik Humburger takmer porazil šampióna Engizeka. Teraz mu organizácia oznámila ďalší skvelý zápas 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/dominik-humburger-takmer-porazil-sampiona-engizeka-teraz-mu-organizacia-oznamila-dalsi-skvely-zapas/ |access-date=2025-11-27 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref> However, Cordero withdrew from the bout due to an injury and was replaced by [[David Zawada]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-26 |title=Dominik Humburger má potvrdený nový zápas! Dátum sa nemení, ale bojovať bude proti inému súperovi 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/dominik-humburger-ma-potvrdeny-novy-zapas-datum-sa-nemeni-ale-bojovat-bude-proti-inemu-superovi/ |access-date=2025-11-27 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref> In turn, Humburger had to withdraw from the bout due to health reasons and was replaced by Daniel Ligocki. On January 11, the promotion announced that Humburger will return at [[Oktagon 87]] on April 25.<ref name="Ligocki">{{Cite web |date=2026-01-10 |title=Žiaľ, turnaj Oktagon 82 hlási nepríjemnú stratu len týždeň pred turnajom. Českého bojovníka však nahradí jeho krajan 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/zial-turnaj-oktagon-82-hlasi-neprijemnu-stratu-len-tyzden-pred-turnajom-ceskeho-bojovnika-vsak-nahradi-jeho-krajan/ |access-date=2026-01-11 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

'''''Oktagon 83: Samsonidse vs. Machaev''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Oktagon MMA]] on January 31, 2026, in [[Stuttgart]], Germany.

===Background===
A [[Oktagon MMA#Featherweight championship|Oktagon Featherweight Championship]] bout for the vacant title between Niko Samsonidse and Mochamed Machaev headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-08 |title=Aktuálne: Nástupca Keitu? Organizácia Oktagon oznámila titulový zápas o post šampióna 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/aktualne-nastupca-keitu-organizacia-oktagon-oznamila-titulovy-zapas-o-post-sampiona/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

Undefeated prospects Frederic Vosgröne and Jesus Samuel Chavarría were scheduled to meet at this event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-22 |title=„Neandertálec“ narazí na neporazeného súpera z Hondurasu. Kto si pripíše na konto svoju prvú porážku? 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/neandertalec-narazi-na-neporazeneho-supera-z-hondurasu-kto-si-pripise-na-konto-svoju-prvu-porazku/ |access-date=2026-01-28 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref> The pairing was originally scheduled to take place at [[Oktagon 78]] in October 2025, but Vosgröne withdrew from the bout before the weigh-ins due to suffered an injury.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-17 |title=Typické zranenie pre tenistov: Jedna z hlavných hviezd Oktagon 78 odstupuje 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/vosgrone-odstupuje-dva-dni-pred-oktagon-78/ |access-date=2025-10-17 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref> In turn, Vosgröne withdrew from the bout due to a shoulder injury and was replaced by Alexander Poppeck.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-26 |title=Frederic Vosgröne Withdraws from Oktagon 83 Due to Shoulder Injury 
|url=https://www.lowkickmma.com/frederic-vosgrone-withdraws-from-oktagon-83-due-to-shoulder-injury/ |access-date=2026-01-28 |website=www.lowkickmma.com |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-28 |title=Frederic Vosgröne odstúpil pre zranenie! Toto je náhradník, ktorý naskočil na poslednú chvíľu pár dní pred Oktagon 83 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/frederic-vosgrone-odstupil-pre-zranenie-toto-je-nahradnik-ktory-naskocil-na-poslednu-chvilu-par-dni-pred-oktagon-83/ |access-date=2026-01-28 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

'''''Oktagon 84: Paradeiser vs. Brito''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Oktagon MMA]] on February 14, 2026, in [[Ostrava]], Czech Republic.

===Background===
A [[Oktagon MMA#Welterweight championship|Oktagon Welterweight Championship]] bout for the vacant title between former [[Oktagon MMA#Lightweight championship|Oktagon Lightweight Champion]] Ronald Paradeiser and former champion Kaik Brito headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-11 |title=Organizácia Oktagon oznámila titulový zápas na turnaj v Ostrave. V hlavnej úlohe Slovák! 
|url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/organizacia-oktagon-oznamila-titulovy-zapas-na-turnaj-v-ostrave-v-hlavnej-ulohe-slovak/ |access-date=2025-12-13 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

A [[Oktagon MMA#Women's flyweight championship|Oktagon Women's Flyweight Championship]] bout for the vacant title between the reigning [[Oktagon MMA#Women's bantamweight championship|Oktagon Women's Bantamweight Champion]] [[Lucia Szabová]] and Leidiane Fernandes was scheduled to co-headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Anderson |first=Jay |date=2026-01-08 |title=Lucia Szabova Will Seek Double Champ Status at Oktagon 84 |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2026/01/08/lucia-szabova-will-seek-double-champ-status-at-oktagon-84/ |access-date=2026-01-11 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref> However, Fernandes withdrew from the bout due to an injury and the fight is expected to be rescheduled for a later date.<ref name="Fernandes injury">{{Cite web |date=2026-01-29 |title=Szabová prišla o súperku. Bude bojovať o titul na turnaji Oktagon 84 v Ostrave? |url=https://www.fightlive.sk/rubriky/oktagon/szabova-prisla-o-superku-nastupi-na-turnaji-oktagon-84-v-ostrave_2373.html |access-date=2026-02-04 |website=FightLive.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

A [[Oktagon MMA#Bantamweight championship|Oktagon Bantamweight Championship]] bout for the vacant title between [[Igor Severino]] and [[2023 in Professional Fighters League#Bantamweight|2023 PFL Europe Bantamweight Tournament]] winner Khurshed Kakhorov was scheduled to take place at the event.<ref name="BWtitle84">{{Cite web |date=2025-11-12 |title=Igor Severino vs. Khurshed Kakhorov Rescheduled for Oktagon 84 Bantamweight Title Clash in Ostrava |url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/igor-severino-vs-khurshed-kakhorov-oktagon-84-bantamweight-title/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=FightBook MMA |language=en-US}}</ref> They were originally scheduled to compete at [[Oktagon 78]] in October 2025, but Kakhorov has been forced to withdraw from the event due to health issues.<ref name=":78">{{Cite web |date=2025-10-18 |title=Aktuálne: Zásadná zmena na poslednú chvíľu v titulovom zápase turnaja Oktagon 78 v Kolíne |url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/aktualne-zapas-na-ktory-sa-vacsina-fanusikov-tesila-je-bohuzial-na-poslednu-chvilu-zruseny/ |access-date=2025-10-18 |website=sport.aktuality.sk |language=sk}}</ref> In turn, the bout was moved to [[Oktagon 85]] on March 7, for unknown reasons.<ref name=":3"/>

Konrad Dyrschka was expected to face returning veteran Matěj Kuzník in a 161 pounds bout. However, Dyrschka was forced to withdraw due to an injury and was replaced by Hafeni Nafuka.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bartos |first=Pavel |date=2025-12-09 |title=Skvělý Oktagon turnaj v Ostravě bohužel přišel o zajímavý zápas |url=https://mmashorties.cz/skvely-oktagon-turnaj-v-ostrave-bohuzel-prisel-o-zajimavy-zapas/ |access-date=2025-05-16 |website=MMA Shorties |language=cs}}</ref>

A middleweight bout between Daniel Ligocki and Milan Ďatelinka was scheduled for this event. However, the bout was removed from the event after Ligocki pulled to face [[David Zawada]] at [[Oktagon 82]] on January 17.<ref name="Ligocki"/>

A middleweight bout between Vašek Klimša and Dawid Januszewski was originally scheduled at this event, but Januszewski pulled out due to an injury and was replaced by Brajan Przysiwek.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bartos |first=Pavel |date=2026-02-04 |title=Uvidíme další specialitu? Oktagon hlásí nový zápas na Ostravu |url=https://mmashorties.cz/uvidime-dalsi-specialitu-oktagon-hlasi-novy-zapas-na-ostravu/ |access-date=2026-02-04 |website=MMA Shorties |language=cs}}</ref>

'''''Oktagon 100: Jotko vs. Muradov''''' will be a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by [[Oktagon MMA]] on December 29, 2026, in [[Prague]], Czech Republic.

===Background===
[[File:O2 Aréna (Prag, CZE).jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[O2 Arena (Prague)|O<sub>2</sub> Arena]] in Prague, will host the 100th numbered event of the organization, since its inception just ten years ago.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-08-03 |title=Oktagon 100 Confirmed for December 29 in O2 Arena |url=https://fightersonly.com/article/ext/94620 |access-date=2026-08-07 |website=Fighters Only |language=en-US}}</ref>]]

A [[Oktagon Middleweight Championship]] bout between the reigning champion [[Krzysztof Jotko]] and current interim champion (also the reigning [[Oktagon Light Heavyweight Championship|Oktagon Light Heavyweight Champion]]) [[Makhmud Muradov]] is scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Łosak |first=Jacek |date=2026-09-26 |title=Wielka walka w wadze średniej. Krzysztof Jotko vs Makhmud Muradov na Oktagon 100 |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/oktagon-100/wielka-walka-w-wadze-sredniej-krzysztof-jotko-vs-makhmud-muradov-na-oktagon-100 |access-date=2026-09-28 |website=MMA Rocks! |language=pl-PL}}</ref> They were initially scheduled to compete at [[UFC Fight Night: Ortega vs. The Korean Zombie]] in October 2020, before the bout being moved to [[UFC Fight Night: Hall vs. Silva]] in two weeks later.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sportyzive.cz/ufc/blizi-se-zapas-makhmuda-muradova-v-ufc/|title=The match of Makhmuda Muradova in the UFC is approaching|publisher=sportyzive.cz|author=Bohuslav Sedláček|date=2020-10-06|access-date=2020-10-06}} {{in lang|cs}}</ref> In turn, Jotko withdrew from the bout due to an injury and was replaced by [[Kevin Holland]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Critchfield |first=Tristen |title=Kevin Holland Replaces Krzysztof Jotko, Faces Makhmud Muradov at UFC Fight Night 181 |url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Kevin-Holland-Replaces-Krzysztof-Jotko-Faces-Makhmud-Muradov-at-UFC-Fight-Night-181-175710/ |access-date=2026-09-28 |website=Sherdog |language=en}}</ref>

Josef Hála and Vladimír Lengál is scheduled is scheduled to compete for the inaugural 75 kg (165 pounds) Oktagon title under "Stand and Bang" rules at the co-main event. This will mark the first title match under "Stand and Bang" rules.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-10-18 |title=Oktagon 100 prinesie historický súboj. Lengál a Hála zabojujú o premiérový titul |url=https://sportnet.sme.sk/spravy/mma-oktagon-100-lengal-vs-hala-titul-stand-and-bang-2026/ |access-date=2026-10-25 |website=Sportnet |language=sk}}</ref>

Former Oktagon Middleweight and Light Heavyweight Champion [[Karlos Vémola]] and former [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Light heavyweight championship|KSW Light Heavyweight Champion]] [[Tomasz Narkun]] are scheduled to meet in a light heavyweight bout.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Stachura |first=Bartłomiej |date=2026-11-03 |title=Tomasz Narkun wystąpi na jubileuszowej gali OKTAGON 100 – zmierzy się z ikoną czeskiego MMA Karlosem Vemolą |url=https://www.lowking.pl/tomasz-narkun-wystapi-na-jubileuszowej-gali-oktagon-100-zmierzy-sie-z-ikona-czeskiego-mma-karlosem-vemola/ |access-date=2026-11-03 |website=Lowking.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

UFC veteran [[Luke Barnatt]] is scheduled to make his return to combat sports after retirement since December 2020, against former [[Bellator Middleweight World Championship|Bellator Middleweight World champion]] [[Attila Végh]] in a catchweight of 98 kg (216 pounds) bout under the "Stand and Bang" rules.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-10-25 |title=Attila Végh je späť a vracia sa do Oktagonu vo veľkom štýle! Jeho súperom bude UFC veterán |url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/mma-fanatik/attila-vegh-je-spat-a-vracia-sa-do-oktagonu-vo-velkom-style-jeho-superom-bude-ufc-veteran/ |access-date=2026-10-25 |website=Sportnet |language=sk}}</ref>
